shared_contract.content: Hero only; no supporting copy, labels or UI. A word appears only when it is the requested hero, as in MELT.

path_convention: detail, demo and implementation resolve relative to this library. Each example selects batches[batch_id]; export resolves in its delivery directory, and source.archive_member resolves inside its editable_archive. Project evidence paths resolve beside that source HTML after extraction. Sound provenance belongs to the selected batch; shared visual settings do not imply shared audio requirements.
